newsitem.title: QATAR: Britain's Prince Charles arrives in Qatar.
newsitem.headline: Britain's Prince Charles arrives in Qatar.

text.p: Britain's Prince Charles arrived in Qatar on Tuesday aboard the royal yacht Britannia on a two-day official visit to the small Gulf Arab state.
He was received at Doha Port by Qatar's heir apparent Sheikh Jassim bin Hamad bin Khalifa al-Thani and other top officials.
Members of the public lined the road to the port to greet the motorcade as it drove to the emiri palace for talks between Prince Charles and Emir Sheikh Hamad bin Khalifa al-Thani.

The prince also visited the Qatargas plant at Ras Laffan, the site of the state's several gas projects, 85 km (50 miles) north of the capital Doha. There he shook hands with six former Gurkhas -- Nepali soldiers who fought alongside British troops in both world wars -- now employed at the plant.
This is Prince Charles's second visit to Qatar. He had previously toured the oil- and gas-rich state in November 1986 accompanied by Princess Diana. The couple have since divorced.
On Wednesday morning, Prince Charles will fly to Bangladesh aboard a royal squadron flight.

The Britannia, on its final overseas voyage before being taken out of service later this year, will continue to India and the Far East. The luxury mini-liner's seven-month deployment will culminate in its visit to Hong Kong in June for the handover ceremonies of the colony to China.
